title: AEIBReceipt_v0.5.0
description: AEIB v0.5.0 execution receipt schema specification. Extends v0.4.0 with stateful continuity proofs (IETF draft-nikolaichuk-scitt-continuity-receipts-00), machine-readable synthetic artifact watermarking (EU AI Act Article 50 / C2PA), ESA incident reporting payloads (EU DORA Article 17), dual-path execution classification, and pluggable sovereign cryptographic profiles.

caid.description: Canonical Action Identifier derived per RFC 8785: CAID = SHA256(Noun || '::' || Verb || '::' || JCS(Payload)).

execution_path.description: Dual-path latency isolation marker. CLARIFICATION_FAST_PATH handles read-only queries with 0ms inline CAS latency; COORDINATION_GATE enforces synchronous atomic CAS locks and RFC 8785 canonicalization for state-mutating dispatches.

disposition.description: Fail-closed disposition vocabulary. DISPATCHED_UNCONFIRMED marks post-dispatch transport ambiguity; OUTCOME_VERIFIED marks out-of-band probe confirmation; CONTINUATION_DESYNC_LOCKED halts execution upon state hash desynchronization across cloud boundaries.

retry_safe.description: Re-dispatch authorization interlock. Latches false on transport drops (HTTP 504 / TCP RST) until out-of-band target probing succeeds.

latch_engaged.description: True when the ANSI 86 software lockout latch is physically engaged for this CAID.

retry_policy.description: Named retry policy (e.g. PROHIBITED_DEFAULT_LATCH, RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY, SLA_ESCALATE_DUAL_CONTROL).

mapping_rule_id.description: Identifier of the transport-to-disposition mapping rule that evaluated this state transition.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 digest over the RFC 8785 canonicalized action payload.

previous_hash.description: Append-only hash chain pointer linking to the immediately preceding receipt in the local audit journal.

canonicalization.description: Binds receipt byte-level serialization to RFC 8785 JCS specifications.

key_sorting.description: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code units.

normalization.description: NFC normalization applied only as opt-in ingress pre-pass; never within JCS core.

continuation_proof.description: State recovery continuation proof across process restarts and distributed cloud cluster boundaries (IETF draft-nikolaichuk-scitt-continuity-receipts-00).

state_recovery_root.description: Merkle root hash of the restored durable state snapshot.

prev_continuation_hash.description: SHA-256 continuation hash of the preceding epoch.

continuation_hash.description: Current continuation hash: SHA256(prev_continuation_hash || state_recovery_root || epoch_index).

checkpoint_authority.description: Identifier of the durable cluster node or orchestrator asserting this checkpoint.

migration_cluster_id.description: Identifier of the destination cluster during cross-region migration.

synthetic_artifact_manifest.description: Machine-readable watermarking and provenance metadata complying with EU AI Act Article 50 (July 2026 Guidelines) and C2PA specifications.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier of the generated or manipulated output artifact.

c2pa_manifest_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the embedded C2PA provenance manifest.

asset_origin.description: Mandatory EU AI Act disclosure category.

generator_id.description: Identifier of the agent runtime, tool invocation, or model instance producing the artifact.

tamper_evidence_digest.description: Integrity checksum binding the synthesized content directly to this receipt.

dora_incident_payload.description: European Supervisory Authority (ESA) major ICT incident classification packet complying with EU DORA Article 17.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the DORA Article 17 incident event.

classification.description: Severity tier assessed according to European Supervisory Authority criteria.

classification_timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp when the technical fault was classified as a reportable incident.

root_cause_vector.description: Primary infrastructure or protocol disturbance mechanism.

economic_impact_estimated_eur.description: Estimated financial exposure resulting from the unconfirmed or double-dispatched effect.

clients_affected_count.description: Number of users, counterparties, or tenants impacted.

reporting_window_deadline_utc.description: Strict 4-hour regulatory notification deadline under DORA Article 17.

esa_submission_status.description: Transmission lifecycle status to the competent national authority or ESMA portal.

signature_algorithm.description: Asymmetric digital signature or zero-knowledge proof algorithm.

probe_authority.description: Identity of the out-of-band probe authority (e.g. SQLiteOutcomeProbeAdapter).

consistency_scope.description: Consistency scope of the target provider database.

signature.description: Digital signature hex over the canonicalized receipt payload.

signer_pubkey.description: Public key hex of the attestor corresponding to crypto_profile.
